name: Seeking Strahad
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak. He is powerful even though he may be small. He can teach you about more powerful summonings--I feel you are ready. Go to him now. He is in Ratchet... above the port town next to his tower.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.

Is that hatred I see in your eyes, adventurer? Good, we will put that to good use.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Jorah Annison in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
